messages:
Aisha (AE): Heads-up: Solasta Systems exec wants final decision this Friday. POC quality is fine but they need capacity guarantees + clarified pricing. Requesting exec-level unblock.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Summary for context: they want a Dedicated pool approx equal to 8x A100, BYO KMS, and VPC peering. Also asked about an intro discount on committed monthly pricing.
Priya (Sales Eng): Legal flagged several redline items around data residency and encryption. Claire, can you expedite?
Claire (Legal): I reviewed the contract. Three items need work: data handling appendix, SOC2 artifact, and a KMS attestation addendum. I can draft the appendix and attestation this afternoon if someone confirms the SOC2 link.
Sam (VP Sales): On pricing we need a decision quickly. Proposal: 25% intro discount for first 3 months with guaranteed dedicated capacity. If Ops/Legal can't accept, minimum fallback is 15% + 6-month commit. Finance input needed.
Jordan (Product): We can reserve capacity but need SRE to confirm provisioning lead time and fallback policies. We should document fallback to hosted variants in case of hardware issues.
Riley (SRE): New dedicated pool provisioning: 48-72 hours after hardware assignment. For reserved contracts we can pre-allocate. Also need customer's network diagram for peering.
Aisha (AE): @Riley can we do a soft reserve so they don't cancel? Customer exec meeting Friday EOD.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Perf snapshot: config X gives ~120 req/s with 128 token avg. Will paste perf snippet.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): ```
# perf estimate
model: redwood-7b-quant
dedicated_nodes: 8
avg_tokens: 128
est_throughput: 110-130 rps
```
Priya (Sales Eng): @Sam if we can't offer 25%, what's minimally acceptable to keep momentum?
Sam (VP Sales): Minimum is 15% with 3-month intro + 6-month committed term. Need Finance signoff.
Claire (Legal): SOC2 snapshot uploaded to internal share: https://redwood.internal/soc2-v2. I'll draft the KMS addendum today.
Riley (SRE): BYO KMS supported via our connector but requires ~1 week for key rotation policy config and trust testing. For faster timeline we can scope a temporary exception with enhanced logging.
Aisha (AE): Actions: 1) Claire finish redline by 5pm. 2) Riley confirm soft reserve feasibility and timeline. 3) Finance to greenlight discount range. 4) Miguel deliver perf estimates and peering checklist. Who owns exec call prep?
Sam (VP Sales): I'll take exec call; Miguel and Priya prep a one-slide summary for Friday. Jordan, loop in Pricing Ops.
Jordan (Product): Pricing Ops: we can approve 20% if SRE confirms reservation and Legal signs KMS addendum.
ops-bot: New task created: #project-solasta-poc - assignees: Aisha, Miguel, Claire, Riley. Due: 2026-03-27.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Sending peering checklist: IP ranges, CIDR, BGP ASN, cert fingerprints, ports.
Priya (Sales Eng): Customer asks about SLA credits. Can we promise an uptime SLA for the dedicated pool during the trial?
Riley (SRE): Trials are typically best-effort. SLA requires formal capacity reservation + support uplift (paid). If Sales wants SLA, mark as paid reserved cluster.
Aisha (AE): Customer prefers SLA. That's why they want discount + reserved capacity.
Sam (VP Sales): Can Legal, SRE, and Pricing Ops do a quick sync at 3:30pm PT to sign off? If yes I'll schedule exec call for Friday 10am PT.
Claire (Legal): I can make 3:30.
Riley (SRE): I'll be there.
Jordan (Product): I'll join for Pricing Ops.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): I'll bring perf numbers & peering checklist.
Aisha (AE): Please post confirmations after 3:30. I'll update customer thread. :pray:
